result.summary: The page is generally well-designed, but a few visual issues were found: duplicate identical restaurant cards, truncated content, and a cut-off category chip.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section with the same image, delivery time, and fee, which looks like a data duplication error
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list or ensure unique content per card

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Bu...' card title and image are truncated at the right edge of the horizontal carousel
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap or reduce card width so full names are visible; add a peek of the next card for scroll affordance

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no visible indication of scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial next chip to indicate horizontal scrolling

issues.description: Illustrated food images use low-contrast, stylized artwork that may not convey meaningful information to screen readers
issues.suggestion: Provide descriptive alt text for restaurant images
